categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Jinming Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: high-end plastic machinery manufacturing, including film blowing machines, casting machines, stretching machines, coating and laminating production lines, and plastic film and bag products manufacturing. The company also develops and sells industrial big data platforms and software related to intelligent manufacturing. Its products serve various industries such as packaging, agriculture, electronics, medical, aerospace, and construction.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced multi-layer co-extrusion technology for producing high-barrier functional soft packaging films and biaxially oriented films (BOPET, BOPP). It has proprietary technologies in multi-layer film blowing (5-11 layers), high-precision coating, and intelligent manufacturing systems. The production methods include extrusion, blowing, casting, stretching, coating, laminating, and digitalized intelligent control integrated with industrial big data platforms. The company also emphasizes green and recyclable packaging solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include high-end plastic product manufacturers in food packaging, medical supplies, agriculture (greenhouse films), electronics, automotive, and construction sectors. Major clients are both domestic large enterprises and international companies across over 50 countries including Japan, Israel, Russia, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Europe. The company serves industries requiring high-performance films such as food preservation, medical infusion bags, agricultural films, and industrial barrier films.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shantou, Guangdong Province. It has a significant international presence with exports to more than 50 countries and regions including Japan, Israel, Russia, Central Asia, South America, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Europe. Domestic sales are concentrated in regions such as East China, South China, North China, and Northeast China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Jinming Machinery is positioned as a midstream to upstream player in the plastic film and packaging supply chain. It manufactures high-end plastic film production equipment and produces functional films and bags, supplying machinery and materials to downstream plastic product manufacturers and packaging companies. The company also engages in R&D and provides integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions, linking raw material suppliers and end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in multi-layer co-extrusion technology, intelligent manufacturing, and green packaging solutions. It invests in R&D for high-barrier films, TPU multi-layer equipment, and long-life agricultural films using advanced materials. Strategic R&D collaborations with universities and international material suppliers focus on smart factory integration, digitalization, and sustainable development. The company aims to lead in smart, green, and high-performance film equipment and solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of high-end plastic machinery (film blowing machines, casting machines, stretching machines, coating and laminating lines) and plastic film and bag products. The company uses a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally. It also earns income from software and industrial big data platform services related to intelligent manufacturing. Non-operating income includes investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the high-end plastic film machinery sector, recognized for breaking import dependencies and achieving international competitiveness. It competes with global manufacturers from Germany, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan in high-precision film equipment. Its competitive advantages include advanced multi-layer co-extrusion technology, intelligent manufacturing integration, and strong R&D capabilities. The company holds a strong market position in China and expanding presence internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 474.37 million, a 4.37% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.11 million, up 5.93%. Total assets reached about RMB 1.52 billion, with steady growth in revenue and cash flow from operations. The company maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades, including new production lines and intelligent manufacturing facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Jinming Machinery emphasizes technological innovation, product customization, and integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions as its core value propositions. It offers high-precision, multi-layer co-extrusion film equipment with superior barrier properties and energy efficiency. The company provides comprehensive lifecycle services including R&D, production, and after-sales support, supported by an industrial big data platform for real-time monitoring and optimization. Its products enable customers to produce high-performance, environmentally friendly films, enhancing competitiveness in global markets.
